title: Convolution
text: Convolution of two inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Computation domain} sets Computation domain; {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Output} sets the data type, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value that block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value that block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N - D array

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | matrix | N - D array

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
